domain: the vicfei dsh plugin family: multi-agent investment committees, quant research plugins, semantic layers, ontology construction for DeepSeek Harness

entity_types.name: agent
entity_types.desc: A CLI agent whose activity and closing words are captured in diary entries.

entity_types.name: diary_entry
entity_types.desc: A single append-only markdown record written per settled turn into a local git repository.

entity_types.name: event
entity_types.desc: A durable session/event stream item such as turn/end or session/disposed emitted by the harness.

entity_types.name: git_repository
entity_types.desc: A user-owned local git repo (GitHub/Gitea/bare) where diary files are appended.

entity_types.name: plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin such as agentdiary, dsh-super-agent, or the vicfei dsh plugin family members.

entity_types.name: session
entity_types.desc: A harness session whose durable session/event stream is subscribed to and which produces turns.

entity_types.name: settlement_reason
entity_types.desc: The reason a turn settled: completed, error, max-tokens, aborted, blocked, interrupted, or forked.

entity_types.name: tool_invocation
entity_types.desc: A tool call made during a turn, summarized in the tool mix (e.g. bash×3, edit×1).

entity_types.name: turn
entity_types.desc: A unit of agent work that settles with a reason such as completed, error, max-tokens, or aborted.

relation_types.name: subscribes_to
relation_types.desc: A plugin subscribes to the durable session/event stream.

relation_types.name: writes_entry_for
relation_types.desc: A plugin appends one diary entry per settled turn.

relation_types.name: stored_in
relation_types.desc: Diary entries are appended into a user-owned git repository.

relation_types.name: belongs_to_session
relation_types.desc: A turn is part of a harness session.

relation_types.name: settles_with
relation_types.desc: A turn ends with a settlement reason such as completed or error.

relation_types.name: performed_by
relation_types.desc: A turn is executed by an agent whose closing words are quoted.

relation_types.name: invokes_tool
relation_types.desc: A turn invokes tools that are summarized in the entry's tool mix.

relation_types.name: sibling_of
relation_types.desc: A plugin is a sibling of another plugin in the same family (e.g. agentdiary CLI, dsh-super-agent).
